title: Working at Height Permit
name: Working at Height Permit
description: Permit for work at height using the avoid, prevent and minimise hierarchy, with equipment, falling-object and rescue controls.

sections.title: WORK-AT-HEIGHT HIERARCHY AND PLANNING
items: The task has been reviewed to avoid work at height where reasonably practicable
Where work at height cannot be avoided, collective fall prevention has been considered before personal protection
Where a fall cannot be prevented, measures minimise the distance and consequences of a fall
The work has been properly planned, supervised and assigned to competent people
Safe access and egress have been planned
Fragile surfaces, openings, edges and changes in level have been identified
Overhead lines, cranes and other overhead hazards have been assessed
Weather and lighting conditions are suitable and stop-work limits are understood

fields.label: Why Work at Height Cannot Be Avoided / Hierarchy Selection

sections.title: FALL PREVENTION AND ACCESS EQUIPMENT
items: Selected access equipment is suitable, stable, strong enough and appropriate for the task duration
Collective edge protection / guardrails are installed where required
Scaffolds, towers and MEWPs have current inspection / handover records where applicable
Ladders are used only where justified by the risk assessment and are secured / positioned correctly
MEWP operators are competent and the machine is suitable for the ground and task where applicable
Work restraint is preferred to fall arrest where personal fall protection is necessary
Anchors and lifelines are suitable, identified and within inspection / certification requirements

fields.label: Access Equipment ID / Scaffold Tag / MEWP Number
Fall Protection System
options: No personal fall protection required - collective controls adequate

sections.title: FALLING OBJECTS AND EXCLUSION ZONE
items: Tools and materials are secured against falling where practicable
Toe boards, brick guards, debris netting or equivalent protection are provided where required
An exclusion zone below / around the work has been established and maintained
People and traffic cannot pass beneath suspended or overhead work unless adequately protected
Materials are stored so they cannot roll, slide or be blown from height

fields.label: Tool / Material Tethering and Falling-Object Controls

sections.title: COMPETENCE, PPE AND RESCUE
items: Workers are trained and competent for the selected access and fall-protection system
Required PPE has been checked before use
A rescue plan has been prepared for foreseeable falls or incapacitation at height
Rescue arrangements do not rely solely on the fire and rescue service
Rescue equipment is available and rescuers are trained where required
Suspension intolerance / trauma has been considered where fall-arrest equipment is used
Communication and emergency arrangements have been briefed to the team

sections.title: COMPLETION AND HAND-BACK
items: All workers, tools and loose materials have been removed from height
Temporary openings and edges have been made safe
Access equipment has been removed, secured or formally handed over
Exclusion zones are only removed when overhead hazards have been eliminated
The area has been inspected and left safe
